iamzifei-gtd-coach-plugin-gtd-coach.description: Personal GTD (Getting Things Done) coach that helps users achieve their annual goals. Use when users mention goals, plans, daily tasks, productivity, time management, task tracking, reviews, or need help breaking down objectives into actionable steps. Automatically remembers user's goals and progress across conversations. Supports multiple languages. 新手引导：输入 `/gtd 新手`、「这个怎么用」「第一次用」「能干嘛」时，走 SKILL.md 的〈新手上路〉，不要直接开始干活。
